release_notes:
Fix tbl_gf_payment_methods column mismatch; scrub committed live keys

Same pattern as the earlier tbl_gf_email_settings fix: five columns were
added to this table by later migrations (StripeInvoiceCreation, ShippingFee,
IsSandbox, RestrictCountryISO, AmountDenomination) without updating this
seed row, so a fresh install failed on this INSERT too ("Column count
doesn't match value count").

Also removes live-looking Stripe keys (sk_live_/pk_live_) and PayPal
credential hashes that were hardcoded in this demo row and shipped in
every installer package. Credential fields are NULL on fresh installs —
customers configure their own gateways in admincp after login.

SECURITY: if the Stripe key was ever live, rotate it in the Stripe
dashboard — this only removes it from future installs/commits, not from
git history or packages already sent to customers.
